title: Golden 2026 Totem of Undying - Happy New Year
description: Celebrate the New Year with style! ✨ This texture pack transforms the traditional Totem of Undying into a Golden 2026 Trophy.
body:
Celebrate the New Year with style! ✨ This texture pack transforms the traditional Totem of Undying into a Golden 2026 Trophy. The perfect companion for starting your new survival world or hardcore adventure this 2026.

🚀 Features:

🏆 Exclusive Design: A shiny, golden 2026 3D-style totem.
⚡ Performance Friendly: Low resolution to ensure no lag on any device.
📱 Multi-platform: Works perfectly on Minecraft Bedrock (MCPE) and Minecraft Java Edition.
